name: IconTheme
desc: Can accommodate one child, specifying the default style for the descendant icons. Commonly used to unify the styles of multiple identical icons, avoiding setting them one by one.

fields.name: data
fields.desc: The set of properties to use for icons in this subtree.

nodes.name: IconTheme Usage
desc: You can obtain the icon theme data through IconTheme.of, or set the default style for the icon components of IconTheme【descendants】, including color, opacity, and size.
